title: Crop Insurance Indemnity Payment, Premium Offset and Assignment of Indemnity to the Association
content:
**Rule.** A Crop Insurance indemnity is paid within the product's indemnity payment period of calendar days after its claim is finalized. Unpaid premium, fees and interest on the policy are first deducted from it (a premium offset and the matching withholding), and the net amount is paid. When an assignment of indemnity to the association is on file, the indemnity is paid jointly to the member and the association and is applied as a principal payment to the assigned operating line automatically as it is paid; otherwise it is paid to the member. An assignment is filed or released only with the member's own signature on the provider's assignment form, and a release requires the association's consent while the assigned line has an outstanding balance. An assignment received after a claim is paid does not redirect that payment.

## The indemnity on the policy record

The indemnity on a policy is the indemnity determined and not yet paid — raised by indemnity determinations, lowered by payments and by amounts withheld to pay unpaid premium. Its activity appears as entries of their own: the gross indemnity determined for the claim; the premium offset, which lowers the premium owed on the policy, matched by an amount withheld from the indemnity, both dated the indemnity payment date and tied to the claim; and the net indemnity paid, with its payment date and its payee — the member, or the member and the association.

An assignment record shows whether the indemnity is assigned and the operating line it is applied to; when an assignment is released the line is cleared.

## Payee and application

| Assignment of indemnity at the time the claim is paid | Payee | Effect on the member's Operating Lines of Credit |
|---|---|---|
| On file | the member and the association jointly | the net indemnity is applied as a principal payment to the assigned operating line |
| Not on file | the member | none |
| Received only after the claim is paid | that payment is not redirected | none for that payment |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical amounts)

A claim is finalized with a gross indemnity of $10,000.00 while $1,200.00 of premium, fees and interest is unpaid on the policy. A premium offset of $1,200.00 is made, with a matching $1,200.00 withheld from the indemnity, and the net $8,800.00 is paid. Where an assignment to the association is on file, the $8,800.00 is paid jointly to the member and the association and becomes an $8,800.00 principal payment on the assigned operating line; where none is on file, the $8,800.00 is paid to the member.

## Points of judgement

- *Signature.* Filing or releasing an assignment takes the member's own signature on the provider's assignment form.
- *Release while the line is owed.* While the assigned operating line has an outstanding balance, a release also requires the association's consent.
- *Timing of payment.* The payment period is counted in calendar days from the date the claim is finalized.
